name: SCRUM-9 - System User Record Count and Empty Results
objective: Verify that displayed user rows match the record count, row actions are present, and no-match searches display an empty state.
precondition: The administrator is logged in and can access System Users.

steps.description: Open the System Users screen and count the displayed records.
steps.expectedResult: The number of user rows matches the record count.
Username, role, employee name, status, and applicable Edit and Delete actions are displayed.

steps.description: Search for a username that does not exist.
steps.expectedResult: No records are shown and the empty-state message is displayed.
